registry_info.description: The hand canvas: a large pane of glass the hands paint on - every fingertip an indicator, the stroke by how many touch at once. Palle, 2026-10-30; after Point Trace's GlassWall.

hand_canvas.name: Hand canvas
hand_canvas.description: A 4 x 2.5 m pane of glass on uprights, like Point Trace's GlassWall, that the HANDS paint: every fingertip of a tracked hand and the knuckle under the middle finger are indicators; one within 2.5 cm of the face leaves a mark, and each frame it stays, a segment. One fingertip paints a thin line, two a double-width one, three wider, four a broad band, the whole hand a soft wash; the left and right hands in their own colours. Paint accumulates in a viewport that never clears. Pens mark it too (ada_writable_board). Config: width, height, px_per_m, touch_depth, left_colour, right_colour, wash_alpha.
